mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_definitions (id, code, quota_definition_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.code}, #{row.status}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, quota_definition_status AS status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quota_definitions WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (id, code, display_name, plan_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.code}, #{row.displayName}, #{row.status}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO plan_quotas (plan_id, quota_definition_id, quota_limit) VALUES (#{row.planId}, #{row.quotaDefinitionId}, #{row.quotaLimit})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, display_name AS displayName, plan_status AS status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM plans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT plan_id AS planId, quota_definition_id AS quotaDefinitionId, quota_limit AS quotaLimit FROM plan_quotas WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions (id, tenant_id, plan_id, subscription_status, ends_at, created_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.planId}, #{row.status}, #{row.endsAt}, #{row.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO entitlement_bootstrap_idempotency (caller_identity_id, idempotency_key, operation_type, request_fingerprint, target_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{row.callerIdentityId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.operationType}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (caller_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT caller_identity_id AS callerIdentityId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, operation_type AS operationType, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, target_id AS targetId, response_status AS responseStatus, response_kind AS responseKind, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody, completed_at AS completedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM entitlement_bootstrap_idempotency WHERE caller_identity_id = #{callerIdentityId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entitlement_outbox_events (event_id, aggregate_id, occurred_at, topic, ordering_key, trace_id, event_snapshot, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{row.eventId}, #{row.aggregateId}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.topic}, #{row.orderingKey}, #{row.traceId}, CAST(#{row.eventSnapshot} AS JSONB), #{row.occurredAt})
